```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(reshape2)
library(cowplot)
library(vegan)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
prok <- readRDS("phyloseq_obj.rds")

samples_to_remove <- c("AVE")
prok <- prune_samples(!(sample_names(prok) %in% samples_to_remove), prok)
prok
```


```{r}

env <- read.csv("./ENV_geochemical_dataset.tsv", sep="\t", header = T, skip = 2)
rownames(env) <- env$ID
env <- as.data.frame(env)

sample_data(prok) <- sample_data(env)
env

sample_data(prok)
```




```{r}

microbiome::readcount(prok)

## Normalizing the asv counts to the median sequencing depth
prok_ndata <- transform_sample_counts(prok, function(x) ((x/sum(x))*median(microbiome::readcount(prok))))



```

```{r}
## Normalizing the asv counts as relative abundances
prok_ndata_ra <- transform_sample_counts(prok_ndata, function(x) x/sum(x) )

```



# ordering
```{r}
sample_order <- sample_data(prok_ndata)[order(sample_data(prok_ndata)$TDS)]$ID
water_order <- c("Low T", "Intermediate T", "High T")
```




# Plot Bar

```{r fig.width=20, fig.height=10}
# Plot Bar


# Phylum
phylum <- tax_glom(prok_ndata, "Phylum")
phylum.ra <- transform_sample_counts(phylum, function(x) x/sum(x) )

# Plot Phylum Relative abundances
plot <- phyloseq::plot_bar(phylum.ra, fill = "Phylum" ) 

  
plot + theme_bw()

```


```{r}

N <- 10
# SORT
top10.phylum <- sort(taxa_sums(phylum.ra), decreasing = TRUE)[1:N]
# GET
phylum.top10.ra <- prune_taxa(names(top10.phylum), phylum.ra) 


p <- plot_bar(phylum.top10.ra, fill = "Phylum", title="Top 10 Phylum" ) + 
  facet_grid(~Water_classification, space="free", scale="free")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#a6cee3', '#1f78b4', '#b2df8a', '#33a02c', '#fb9a99',
                               '#d25b6a', '#fbbd75', '#ff8f00', '#cab2d6', "#6a3d9a")) +
  ylab("Rel. Abundance") +
  xlab("Sample") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1.0, hjust=1))

p$data$Sample <- factor(p$data$Sample, levels = sample_order)
p$data$Water_classification <- factor(p$data$Water_classification, levels = water_order)

p

```

# Alpha Diversity ( Samples )

```{r}

# ── Prepara phyloseq raw ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
prok_alpha <- prune_species(speciesSums(prok) > 0, prok)

# ── Arrotonda a interi ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
otu_table(prok_alpha) <- otu_table(
  round(otu_table(prok_alpha)),
  taxa_are_rows = taxa_are_rows(prok_alpha)
)

# ── Alpha diversity ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
alpha_div <- estimate_richness(prok_alpha,
                               measures = c(
                                 "Observed",
                                 "Shannon", 
                                 "Simpson")) 
 # %>%  # 
  # mutate(Pielou = Shannon / log(Observed))

alpha_div[sample_order,]

```


```{r}
colnames(alpha_div)

alpha_out <- alpha_div[sample_order, c("Observed", "Shannon", "Simpson")]
alpha_out$sample_id <- rownames(alpha_out)
alpha_out$Shannon <- round(alpha_out$Shannon, 2)
alpha_out$Simpson <- round(alpha_out$Simpson, 2)

alpha_out
write.csv(alpha_out[, c("sample_id", "Observed", "Shannon", "Simpson")], "alpha_diversity_values.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```





# NMDS CON 2 FIT

```{r}



library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# =========================================================
# 1. TOP10 FAMILY
# =========================================================

prok_global_nmds <- family.top10.ra

# =========================================================
# 2. SAMPLE ORDER
# =========================================================

rn_sorted <- sample_names(prok_global_nmds) %>%
  sort()

rn_sorted

# =========================================================
# 3. TOP10 FAMILY MATRIX
# rows = samples
# cols = taxa
# =========================================================

diversity <- prok_global_nmds %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  select(Family, Sample, Abundance) %>%
  filter(
    !Family %in% c(
      "Unknown Family",
      "Incertae Sedis"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Sample,
    values_from = Abundance
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

diversity[is.na(diversity)] <- 0

rownames(diversity) <- diversity$Family

diversity$Family <- NULL

diversity <- diversity[, rn_sorted]

# transpose:
# rows = samples
# cols = family

taxa_matrix <- t(diversity) %>%
  as.data.frame()

taxa_matrix

# =========================================================
# 4. ENVIRONMENTAL VARIABLES
# =========================================================

full_cols <- c(
  "ID","Water_classification",
  "Depth","T","pH","TDS","NH4","HCO3",
  "Na","K","Mg2","Ca2","F","Cl","NO2","Br",
  "NO3","SO4","B","SiO2","TDP","COD",
  "delta13C_TDIC","delta18O_H2O","delta2H_H2O","Li","Al","V","Cr","Mn",
  "Fe","Co","Ni","Cu","Zn","As","Rb",
  "Sr","Mo","Sb","Cs","Ba","Tl","Pb","U"
)


cols_NMDS_3 <- c(
  "NH4", "HCO3", "K", "Mg2", "Ca2", "F", "Cl", "NO3", "SO4", "B", "SiO2", "COD", 
  "Al", "V", "Mn", "Fe", "Ni", "Cu", "Zn", "As", "Mo", "Sb", "Tl", "Pb"  
)

cols <- cols_NMDS_3
cols_fit <- cols_NMDS_3 

new_env <- as(sample_data(prok), "data.frame")

# =========================================================
# 5. GEO MATRIX FOR NMDS
# rows = samples
# cols = geochemical variables
# =========================================================

geo_matrix <- new_env[rn_sorted, cols] %>%
  as.data.frame()

geo_matrix

# remove all-zero variables if present

geo_matrix <- geo_matrix[, colSums(geo_matrix, na.rm = TRUE) > 0]

# =========================================================
# 6. NMDS ON GEOCHEMISTRY
# =========================================================

set.seed(42)

nmds <- metaMDS(
  geo_matrix,
  distance = "bray",
  trymax = 100
)

nmds

# =========================================================
# 7. SAMPLE SCORES
# =========================================================

nmds_scores <- as.data.frame(
  scores(nmds, display = "sites")
)

nmds_scores$SampleID <- rownames(nmds_scores)

# =========================================================
# 8. ADD METADATA
# =========================================================

meta_df <- new_env[rn_sorted, full_cols]

nmds_scores <- cbind(
  nmds_scores[rn_sorted, ],
  meta_df[rn_sorted, ]
)

nmds_scores

# =========================================================
# 9. ENVFIT TAXA
# =========================================================

fit_taxa <- envfit(
  nmds,
  taxa_matrix,
  permutations = 999
)

# =========================================================
# 10. TAXA VECTORS
# =========================================================

taxa_vectors <- scores(
  fit_taxa,
  display = "vectors"
)

taxa_df <- as.data.frame(taxa_vectors)

taxa_df$Taxon <- rownames(taxa_df)

taxa_df$pval <- fit_taxa$vectors$pvals

taxa_df$fontface <- ifelse(
  taxa_df$pval < 0.05,
  "bold",
  "plain"
)

taxa_df$col <- ifelse(
  taxa_df$pval < 0.05,
  "gray20",
  "grey80"
)

taxa_df

# =========================================================
# 11. ENVFIT GEOCHEMISTRY
# =========================================================

geo_fit_matrix <- new_env[rn_sorted, cols_fit] %>%
  as.data.frame()

fit_geo <- envfit(
  nmds,
  geo_fit_matrix,
  permutations = 999,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# =========================================================
# 12. GEO VECTORS
# =========================================================

geo_vectors <- scores(
  fit_geo,
  display = "vectors"
)

geo_df <- as.data.frame(geo_vectors)

geo_df$Variable <- rownames(geo_df)

geo_df$pval <- fit_geo$vectors$pvals

geo_df$fontface <- ifelse(
  geo_df$pval < 0.05,
  "bold",
  "plain"
)

geo_df$col <- ifelse(
  geo_df$pval < 0.05,
  "gray20",
  "grey80"
)

geo_df


```

```{r}
scale_factor <- 0.55
```


```{r}
p_taxa <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = nmds_scores,
    aes(
      NMDS1,
      NMDS2,
      color = "grey90"
    ),
    size = 6
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = taxa_df,
    aes(
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      xend = NMDS1 * scale_factor,
      yend = NMDS2 * scale_factor,
      color = col
    ),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "in")),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = taxa_df,
    aes(
      NMDS1 * scale_factor,
      NMDS2 * scale_factor,
      label = Taxon,
      fontface = fontface
    ),
    size = 6,
    color = "black",
    max.overlaps = 100
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "NMDS1",
    y = "NMDS2"
  )

p_taxa
```

# PERMANOVA
```{r}

# Tabella ASV (campioni sulle righe) e metadati
comm <- as(otu_table(prok_ndata_ra), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(prok_ndata_ra)) comm <- t(comm)

meta <- data.frame(sample_data(prok_ndata_ra))[rownames(comm), ]

meta$Water_classification <- factor(meta$Water_classification,
                                    levels = c("Low T", "Intermediate T", "High T"))

meta



```


```{r}

# PERMANOVA su Bray-Curtis
dist_comm <- vegdist(comm, method = "bray")
dist_comm
 
```

```{r}

# Permanova
set.seed(42)
adonis2(dist_comm ~ Water_classification, data = meta, permutations = 9999)

```

```{r}
 
# Controllo delle dispersioni
set.seed(42)
permutest(betadisper(dist_comm, meta$Water_classification), permutations = 9999)

```




# Faprotax INPUT


```{r}
data.frame(t(otu_table(prok)))
```



```{r}

input_fpt <- prok_ndata  

phydf <- as.data.frame(tax_table(input_fpt))

phydf[is.na(phydf)] <- ""

# columns to paste together
cols <- c( "Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species" )

# create a new column `x` with the three columns collapsed together
phydf$taxonomy <- apply( phydf[ , cols ] , 1 , function(i){ paste(na.omit(i), collapse = ";") } )

# TMMnorm <- function(counts_matrix){
#   # Main Reference: https://www.biostars.org/p/9465851/
#   # Secondary References: https://www.biostars.org/p/9475236/
#   # Samples as colnames
#   # Features as rownames 
#   
#   y <- edgeR::DGEList(as.matrix(counts_matrix))
#   y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(y)
#   
#   return(as.data.frame(cpm(y, log=TRUE)))#, prior.count=2)))
# }

otu <- as.data.frame(otu_table(input_fpt))

# with t_otu samples are in columns and ASVs in rows
# tmm_otu <- TMMnorm(t_otu)
# otu_to_merge <- tmm_otu

t_otu <- as.data.frame(t(otu))
otu_to_merge <- t_otu


m <- merge(otu_to_merge, phydf[, "taxonomy", drop=F], by = 0, all.x = T )
# m
m$Row.names <- gsub('ASV', 'OTU', m$Row.names)
colnames(m)[1] <- "OTU"
# 
rownames(m) <- m$OTU
m$OTU <- rownames(m)
rownames(m) <- NULL

# colnames(otu_faprotax)[1] <- "OTU"
n <- ncol(m)
new.order = c(n, 1:(n-1))
m <- m[, new.order]
m <- m[, c("taxonomy", "OTU", rownames(sample_data(input_fpt)) )]
m

```


```{r}
write.table(m, "./faprotaxTableInput-prok_ndata.tsv", quote = F, sep = "\t", row.names = F, col.names = T)
```



# FAPROTAX HEATMAP

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=5}
library(pheatmap)
library(ComplexHeatmap)


faprotax <- as.matrix(read.csv("./faprotax_results_prok-ndata/results.txt", 
                     sep="\t", row.names = 1))

faprotax <- faprotax[which(rowSums(faprotax) > 0), ]
faprotax <- faprotax[, which(colSums(faprotax) > 0)]

faprotax <- faprotax[, c("LOP","SAM","ESP","COS","CAR","TOR","TPUT","PIS","NER","FSCO")]



draw(ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(faprotax, scale="row", 
                         # annotation_col = annotation_col,

                         cluster_cols = T,
                         legend = TRUE,
                         heatmap_legend_param = list(
                           legend_direction = "horizontal",

                           # annotation_legend_side = "bottom",

                         main = "Faprotax Metabolism"), 
     annotation_legend_side = "left",
     heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
```

# Faprotax - Nitrogen

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=5}

nitrogen_cycle <- c(
  "anammox",
  "nitrate_denitrification",
  "nitrite_denitrification",
  "nitrous_oxide_denitrification",
  "denitrification",
  "nitrogen_fixation",
  "nitrate_ammonification",
  "nitrite_ammonification",
  "nitrite_respiration",
  "nitrate_respiration",
  "nitrate_reduction",
  "nitrogen_respiration"
)

nitro <- subset(faprotax, rownames(faprotax) %in% nitrogen_cycle)

# nitro <- nitro[which(rowSums(nitro) > 0),]
# nitro <- nitro[, which(colSums(nitro) > 0)]

nitro[is.nan(nitro)] <- 0


# png(file="faprotax_nitrogen.png", width=6,height=5,units="in",res=300)
fnitro <- ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(nitro, scale = "row", cluster_cols = F, 
                         # annotation_col = annotation_col, 
                         # annotation_colors = ann_colors,
                         legend = TRUE,
                         heatmap_legend_param = list(
                           title = "Row-scaled abundance",
```

# Carbon Plot Bar


```{r}
melted_metadata <- psmelt(prok_ndata)
melted_metadata <- melted_metadata[, c("Sample", "Water_classification")]
melted_metadata <- unique(melted_metadata)
rownames(melted_metadata) <- NULL
melted_metadata

```



```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
carbon_df <- as.data.frame(carbon)
carbon_df$carbon_metab <- rownames(carbon_df)  # aggiunge una colonna con i nomi di riga

carbon_melt <- melt(carbon_df, id.vars = "carbon_metab", value.name = "Abundance", na.rm = FALSE)

colnames(carbon_melt) <- c("carbon_metab", "Sample", "Abundance")

# Unisci questa informazione al melt
carbon_melt <- left_join(
  carbon_melt,
  melted_metadata,
  by = "Sample"
)

carbon_melt

carbon_melt$Water_classification <- factor(carbon_melt$Water_classification, levels = water_order)

# ordering by TDS desc
carbon_melt$Sample <- factor(carbon_melt$Sample, levels = sample_order)



plotbar_CARBON <- ggplot(carbon_melt, aes(x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = carbon_metab)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color="black") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#a6cee3', '#1f78b4', '#b2df8a', '#33a02c', '#fb9a99',
                               '#d25b6a', '#fbbd75', '#ff8f00', '#cab2d6', "#6a3d9a",
                               "#FFEF33", "#A65628")) +
  facet_grid(~Water_classification, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x",
             labeller = labeller(Water_classification = label_wrap_gen(width = 10))) +  
  labs(x = "Sample", y = "FAPROTAX Functional Abundance", fill = "Carbon metabolism") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "right",
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        # strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x.bottom = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank()
    )

# Estrai solo la legenda
# carbon_legend <- get_legend(plotbar_CARBON +
#                               theme(legend.position = "right",
#                                     legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
#                                     legend.text = element_text(size = 9)))

plotbar_CARBON

# Mostra solo la legenda

```
